notes: First full-library scan: 562 folders and 11,670 files, matching the filesystem exactly, with zero NWError 12 across ~11,700 connections and a 16.9-second rescan when nothing had changed. Built walk-connection resilience (item 6) and finally verified mtime-based tag-edit detection with a real Mp3tag edit. Fixed a retry scheduler that could hang the pipeline permanently, leaked a connection per pass, and lost its log session tag. The run exposed that the app cannot account for what it intended to import versus what actually landed -- 20 tracks and 5 albums left the retry queue with no record of being processed. That design is captured in HANDOFF-scan-session-ledger-2026-07-31.md and logged as fScanSessionLedger (Critical).
